title: Import wizard defaults to "Map columns manually" even when the object ships exactly one saved mapping, so a user who does not open the menu imports without its synonym tables — preselect the only mapping (hotcrm#2194 T1-U06)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 导入向导默认「手工映射」，即使对象只有一个随应用发布的映射；不打开菜单的用户就绕过了同义词表，示例模板 3 行丢 2 行。
- **要做：** 原定并入 #13156，但该卡在裁决前已关闭，只修了 CSV 请求。对象恰有一个映射时默认选中它。
- **完成标准：** 只有一个映射的对象打开导入即已选中该映射。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T1-U06**, ruled as a fold into #13156. That card closed `completed` on 2026-10-20T06:29Z, before the ruling, fixing the CSV request but not the preselection, so the item is filed here (see *Why*). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** HotCRM Leads / Accounts / Contacts → Import, sales manager and admin.
- **Now:** "Saved mapping: — Map columns manually —" is the default. A user who doesn't open that menu imports without the synonym tables; the repo's own template then loses 2 of 3 rows.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 1 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/REPORT.md), U-06; [`97-ux-U-06-import-mapping-not-preselected.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/97-ux-U-06-import-mapping-not-preselected.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 1 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).
- **The carrier:** #13156 (PR #13170) made the wizard send a CSV-declared mapping as CSV. It did not change the default selection.

## Landing

Read on objectui `origin/main` `74ebad09`:
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`: `mappingName` starts `null` (~:2349) and is set only by `handleSelectSavedMapping` (~:2371); the fetched list is `availableMappings` (~:2360). A mapping whose mode the target refuses is listed disabled and never applied (#12697), so it does not count as "the only one".

## Done when

- When exactly one applicable saved mapping exists for the object, the wizard opens with it selected; with zero or several, nothing changes.
- The user can still switch to manual mapping.
- A wizard test for one, zero and two mappings.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `import`, `mapping`. 1 open hit: #13330 (cloud-managed Users), not on point; the closed #13315, #13230, #13156 and #13124 are other import defects. **New.**
